official_sources.title: RFC 8259 object-name uniqueness
official_sources.finding: JSON object names SHOULD be unique; duplicate names produce unpredictable receiver behaviour.

official_sources.title: RFC 8259 finite JSON numbers
official_sources.finding: Infinity and NaN are outside the JSON number grammar and are not permitted.

official_sources.title: Python json object_pairs_hook
official_sources.finding: object_pairs_hook receives ordered name/value pairs and can implement duplicate-key rejection.

official_sources.title: Python json parse_constant
official_sources.finding: parse_constant is called for NaN and positive/negative Infinity and can raise on invalid JSON numbers.

official_sources.title: Python JSON allow_nan control
official_sources.finding: Strict output uses allow_nan=false so non-finite values cannot be serialized as non-standard JSON.

official_sources.title: Python os.replace atomic replacement
official_sources.finding: Temporary-file writes followed by os.replace provide atomic destination replacement on the supported filesystem contract.

official_sources.title: GitHub repository contents update contract
official_sources.finding: Existing files require their blob SHA; serial writes avoid update conflicts and 409 conflicts remain fail-closed.

official_sources.title: Git reference compare-and-swap contract
official_sources.finding: A ref update can verify the old object ID; non-force updates avoid overwriting concurrent branch work.

candidates.name: Idempotent sequence-aware retry under branch races
